name: Windows
description: A collection of all the Window objects in Microsoft Excel.
remarks: The Windows collection for the Application object contains all the windows in the application, whereas the Windows collection for the Workbook object contains only the windows in the specified workbook.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

properties.name: SyncScrollingSideBySide
properties.description: True enables scrolling the contents of windows at the same time when documents are being compared side by side. False disables scrolling the windows at the same time.

methods.name: Arrange
methods.signature: Arrange([ArrangeStyle As XlArrangeStyle], [ActiveWorkbook As Variant], [SyncHorizontal As Variant], [SyncVertical As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Arranges the windows on the screen.

parameters.name: ArrangeStyle
parameters.description: One of the constants of XlArrangeStyle specifying how the windows are arranged.

parameters.name: ActiveWorkbook
parameters.description: True to arrange only the visible windows of the active workbook. False to arrange all windows. The default value is False.

parameters.name: SyncHorizontal
parameters.description: Ignored if _ActiveWorkbook_ is False or omitted. True to synchronize the windows of the active workbook when scrolling horizontally. False to not synchronize the windows. The default value is False.

parameters.name: SyncVertical
parameters.description: Ignored if _ActiveWorkbook_ is False or omitted. True to synchronize the windows of the active workbook when scrolling vertically. False to not synchronize the windows. The default value is False.

methods.name: CompareSideBySideWith
methods.description: Opens two windows in side-by-side mode. Returns a Boolean value.

methods.name: BreakSideBySide
methods.description: Ends side-by-side mode if two windows are in side-by-side mode. Returns a Boolean value that represents whether the method was successful.

methods.name: ResetPositionsSideBySide
methods.description: Resets the position of two worksheet windows that are being compared side by side.
